definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese figurine of a cat with one paw raised in a beckoning gesture. Believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and customers to businesses. Commonly displayed in shops, restaurants, and homes.

examples.japanese: お{店|みせ}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}に{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}が{置|お}いてある。
examples.english: There's a lucky cat figurine at the entrance of the shop.

examples.japanese: {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}は{商売繁盛|しょうばいはんじょう}の{縁起物|えんぎもの}だ。
examples.english: The beckoning cat is a good luck charm for business prosperity.

examples.japanese: お{土産|みやげ}に{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a lucky cat figurine as a souvenir.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{招|まね}く (to beckon) + {猫|ねこ} (cat)

SYMBOLISM OF RAISED PAW:
・{右手|みぎて}を{上|あ}げる (right paw raised) - invites money/fortune
・{左手|ひだりて}を{上|あ}げる (left paw raised) - invites customers/people
・{両手|りょうて}を{上|あ}げる (both paws raised) - invites both (though some consider this greedy)

COLOR MEANINGS:
・{白|しろ} (white) - general good luck
・{黒|くろ} (black) - protection from evil
・{金|きん} (gold) - wealth and prosperity
・{赤|あか} (red) - protection from illness
・{桃色|ももいろ}/ピンク (pink) - love and relationships

ORIGINS:
・Originated during the Edo period
・{豪徳寺|ごうとくじ} (Gotokuji Temple) in Tokyo is famous for {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}
・{常滑焼|とこなめやき} (Tokoname ware) is a famous production area

RELATED TERMS:
・{縁起物|えんぎもの} (good luck charm)
・{商売繁盛|しょうばいはんじょう} (business prosperity)
・{千客万来|せんきゃくばんらい} (flood of customers)

MODERN USE:
・Ubiquitous in Japanese businesses, especially restaurants and shops
・Popular as souvenirs and gifts
・Has become internationally recognized
